sans.$description: All interface text. Loaded with next/font/google (weights 400, 500, 600). No second face: tabular figures cover IDs, times, and numbers.

size.$description: Magnitude scale (Tailwind-style names) from the type scale tool, 2026-11-20: base 13px, major-second (1.125), rounded by the tool. For one-off use; components use the type roles.

metric.$description: Key numbers in a metric strip or the brand block (18 of 31). Tabular figures. Size 23px (tool step 5; preview 24px). Line height 1.1: a single line of figures, no wrapping.

title.$description: Page title, one per screen (Today's board). Size 21px (tool step 4; preview 20px). Line height 1.3, tool suggestion. Tighter tracking at display size.

heading.$description: Panel and section headings, dialog titles, the featured job's title. Size 15px (tool step 1; preview 15px). Line height 1.333 (20px), between the tool's 1.5 for body and 1.3 for titles: headings rarely wrap.

body.$description: Reading text: descriptions, notes, form values, menu items. Size 13px (tool base; preview 13px). Line height 1.5, the tool's suggestion, for wrapped text.

body-strong.$description: Emphasis inside body text and key values in detail views (assigned tech, arrival time). Same as body at 600 (preview 500; Atkinson Hyperlegible Next at 500 is too close to 400 at 13px to read as emphasis).

data.$description: Table cells and dense list rows; use with tabular figures for IDs, times, and numbers. Size 13px. Line height 1.385 (18px) so rows stay compact; cells don't wrap.

label.$description: Form labels, column headers, button text, chip text. Size 12px (tool step -1; preview 11px, raised for legibility in Atkinson at 500). Line height 1.333 (16px), single line.

overline.$description: Small uppercase group labels above fields, menu groups, or sections. Set uppercase by the text-overline utility. Size 11px, hand-tuned between tool steps -2 (10px, which the tool flags as small) and -1 (12px): uppercase and tracking make up the size. Line height 1.273 (14px).
